symptom: generate_qwen3_tts -o S01.wav writes MP3 payload because graph uses SaveAudioMP3; wave.open on generated take is not valid PCM input.
root_cause: Output filename suffix does not select graph codec. Metadata and returned source filename confirm SaveAudioMP3 output.
fix: Preserved original takes, decoded each to separate selected PCM24 48kHz mono WAV before timing and InfiniteTalk driving. Verified sample counts with wave.open.
prevention: Probe container, not suffix; generate MP3 with mp3 suffix or explicitly transcode selected working WAV before PCM-specific tools. Do not claim transcoding restores source fidelity.
